answer: Locks are logged in canyon, expire in delta, and pearl lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 109 aliases therefore needs 36 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2935 identities would post 1743 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
